narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. Now it takes either. [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. The new loader leaves unset flags unset. Unset now means off. [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)

The 8 warnings left are real deprecations. `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher`, and 5 more.

Next: clear those deprecations before v5.
